whole_event.gene_filter: CPM >=1 in at least 3 of the 13 primary samples
whole_event.sensitivity_distance: Euclidean distance after gene-wise z-scaling across the 13 primary samples using population standard deviation (ddof=0); zero-variance genes removed
whole_event.recovery_exact_test: one-sided exact permutation over the 6 DTP/regrowth labels; statistic median(DTP distance)-median(regrowth distance)
whole_event.heldout_boundary_test: one-sided exact permutation over the 6 regrowth/resistant labels; statistic median(resistant distance)-median(regrowth distance)
whole_event.control_sensitivity: repeat event distance calculations after adding the 3 barcoded DMSO controls, without changing the gene filter rule
whole_event.no_multiple_testing_promotion: exact tests are resolution diagnostics; effect direction and frozen heldout consistency are primary

modal.basis: PCA/SVD fitted only to the 13 primary samples after gene-wise z-scaling using primary-sample mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) of the frozen filtered logCPM matrix
modal.retention: minimum leading PCs reaching >=80% cumulative variance
modal.return_vector_metric: cosine between DTP-to-regrowth centroid displacement and DTP-to-control centroid displacement in retained-PC space
modal.purpose: distinguish direct modal return, compensatory reorganization, persistent displacement, or divergence

scalar.reason: No source-native dynamical generator is defined for this RNA state-space branch and static PCA is not sufficient to license a same-mode dynamical scalar.

behavioral_anchor.regrowth: paper reports re-sensitivity to CPT-11 upon reinjection/rechallenge
behavioral_anchor.resistant: paper reports continued growth on CPT-11 and resistance upon reinjection/rechallenge
behavioral_anchor.interpretation: group-level source behavior anchor only; not an individual-level predictive endpoint
